plan.recovery: Hold the PRG (BOOT) button, tap RST, then release PRG to enter the ROM bootloader. Unplug and replug the USB cable, then run the flash again. If the port does not appear, try another cable (many are charge-only). Unplug the board and replug it. If it no longer shows as a serial port or drive, put it in its bootloader (see the board recovery steps) and run the flash again. A board is very rarely bricked: the ROM bootloader on ESP32 and the UF2 bootloader on nRF52 survive a failed flash.
